review.summary: I reviewed only the WP-06 navigation diff and the context provided. I found no BLOCKER or MAJOR defects. The LINE entry uses `ownerOnly`, which hides it from admin, accountant, support, users with no role, and platform admins. That matches the owner-only guard on the existing LINE page, and no server permissions change. The `/partner-pages` entry needs the `funnel_builder` feature and has no role flag. That keeps role and feature filtering as they were and lets owner, admin and accountant see it, while support stays limited to its allowlist. The settings menu now lists `/settings/line` where `/settings/commissions` used to be. The new page sends visitors to `/affiliates`, and that page's own checks still decide access. One MINOR issue: nothing tests the redirect, and the diff doesn't show where the new page file lives. No findings here doesn't mean tests or a release passed.

findings.file: New page (path not shown in diff; expected src/app/(app)/settings/commissions/page.tsx)
findings.area: CommissionSettingsPage redirect and the app-shell.test.ts route-existence test
findings.issue: The redirect from the old commissions address to /affiliates is one of the required outcomes, but no test covers it. The diff also doesn't show the new page's file path. The new route-existence test only checks that `/settings/commissions` is no longer in the navigation. It never checks that a page exists at `settings/commissions/page.tsx` or that the page calls `redirect("/affiliates")`.
findings.evidence: The diff shows the page under the label 'New page:' with no file header. In app-shell.test.ts, `expect(links.has("/settings/commissions")).toBe(false)` is the only assertion about commissions, and the loop that checks pages exist only runs over links that are still in the navigation.
findings.impact: If the page is in the wrong folder, the old address still returns 404, and nothing in the test suite would catch it. Saved bookmarks would break even though the requirement says they should redirect.
findings.recommended_fix: Confirm the page is at src/app/(app)/settings/commissions/page.tsx, or at whatever route group serves /settings/*. Then add a test that mocks `next/navigation` `redirect`, renders or calls the page, and asserts the call `redirect("/affiliates")`. Also assert that the page file exists.
findings.required_test: A unit test that imports the commissions settings page with a mocked `redirect` and checks it is called once with "/affiliates", plus an existence check for the page file at the expected route path.
